rules.why: Normal serum tumor markers (AFP, LDH, CEA, and β-HCG) do not specifically distinguish between the candidate diagnoses, leading to a neutral effect for most conditions, with seminoma and NSGCT being ruled out due to the absence of elevated tumor markers typically associated with these conditions.
